cards.title: Top of the Ladder
cards.instruction: Carry yourself as the highest-status person present. Treat questions as requests for your approval.

cards.title: Yes, but My Way
cards.instruction: Agree with others, then reinterpret the agreement entirely in your favor.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Yes, your request for sofa-moving assistance is approved. I'll take the cushions.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: They're sewn on. Can we lift together?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Together is approved. You lift; I'll give the countdown.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I mean two people underneath it.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Agreed. Two lifters are authorized. You may hire the second on your phone; I'll ensure you both receive the same countdown.
